cdpCaptureLimitation.observed: Chrome CDP Page.captureScreenshot at page zoom Z covers only innerWidth/dpr CSS px (measured 1151/1.25=920.8 CSS px at 125%), i.e. the leftmost ~80% of the CSS viewport; captureBeyondViewport and clip.scale do not change it.
cdpCaptureLimitation.consequence: the opt-in entry lives in the fixed right operation column hugging the viewport right edge, so it is outside every CDP capture at 125%; pixel evidence at 125% therefore uses a real display capture.
